contributions.detail: Form A (p5) is an entirely blank grid -- an honest empty period, not a gap. Its printed footer TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS cell holds a BARE DASH, which under the repo's zero-glyph ruling is BLANK, not a numeral (the county's spreadsheet template prints a dash for a nil accounting total); the cover's line-1 THIS cell holds the same bare dash, while the CUMULATIVE cell carries 345.10 forward from report 1. The schedule is therefore PER-PERIOD -- a different scope from the CUMULATIVE figure this module publishes, so reconciles_contrib should be left blank rather than scored a failure. NB this cover is the 3-LINE VARIANT: it has NO 'Aggregate total of contributions of $50.00 or less' line at all, so cover_le50_* do not exist (null, never 0).

Field-shift screen: the single date cell on each of p2/p3 holds a date, the name cells hold names, name count = amount count on both sides.

gates.balance_chain: Report 1 CLOSES: 0.00 + 345.10 - 345.10 = 0.00 = cover line 4 in all three columns. Reports 2 and 3 CLOSE: cumulative 345.10 - 345.10 = 0, and the balance line prints a bare dash (nil) in all three columns. CROSS-FILING CHAIN (run because this PDF holds three filings by one filer in one cycle): report 1's CUMULATIVE column (345.10 contributions / 345.10 expenses / 0.00 balance) chains EXACTLY into report 2's 'Total LAST Report' column (345.10 / 345.10 / -), and report 2's cumulative chains exactly into report 3's LAST column. The three covers are in chronological order and correctly linked -- no swapped-cover indication anywhere in the bundle.

notes: BUNDLE of 3 reports in chronological order (6/12/2024, 10/15/2024, 12/6/2024) -- agrees with the chunk file's n_reports=3. Every cover confirms the chunk file: 'Full Name of Candidate Ryan Sullivan', 'Candidate for Office Of Clerk-Auditor' (chunk says Clerk/Auditor -- same office). County office, in scope. TWO FORM SUB-GENERATIONS INSIDE ONE PDF: report 1 uses the 4-line county-branded cover (colour 'WASHINGTON COUNTY UTAH' logo, lines 1-4 including the <=$50 aggregate), while reports 2 and 3 use the later 3-LINE 'AMERICA'S COUNTY' cover which OMITS the <=$50 aggregate line entirely -- so cover_le50_* is null (field does not exist), never 0, for those two. Report 3's cover also carries a clerk verification block: RECEIVED DEC 06 2024, verifying-inspection date 12/9/2024, 'Eric Clarke, Washington County Attorney (Designated inspector for filings for the office of Washington County Clerk-Auditor)' -- the Clerk-Auditor's own filing is inspected by the County Attorney. CROSS-CHANNEL RE-POST: filing_totals.csv records raw/live_outpost/Ryan Sullivan_ClerkAuditor_FINAL_12-12-2024.pdf as the SAME report as pages 7-9 here; both are in the queue and neither was skipped. index.csv classifies this file format='text' because a stamped transmittal note carries a text layer; the report faces were read as page images per the brief. The candidate's email and phone are printed in the clear on report 1's cover and were DISCARDED at read time (his street address and city/state/zip lines were left blank by the filer).
